title: Ventkids/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Ventkid: "Need a ride Glinty? K-Drives by the load! Just through that vent there."
- Ventkid: "Check the vent Glinty! Just here, a paying customer is always welcome."
- Ventkid: "Pobbers are smart, but for me, Kubrodons all the way! Flash, style, attitude. Ride godly and be remembered!"
- Ventkid: "Vent Pobbers make it happen! Not Kubrodon flashy, but they can take anything stolen and turn it into a top ride!"
- Ventkid: "Pobbers and Kubrodons. Sure they go at each other but it's all good fun. Only got to hear us skegging out together to know that for a fact."
